## LGDA Autonomic Pacing Node (Remote)

The LGDA Autonomic Pacing Node is a remote MCP server that sells LGDA Technologies wellness music to AI agents. Agents browse a catalog of 27 tracks across 9 albums, check per-track biometric session evidence, and pay with x402 USDC on Base — $5.99 per track, $14.99 per album, or $0.05 for a single session play — receiving the real MP3 with an Ed25519-signed receipt. Sessions measure heart rate and HRV via camera while the music plays, so the receipt carries before-and-after evidence. Wellness music only, not a medical device.
